    css: styles.css
---

```{r}
library(highcharter)

nodes <- list(
  list(id = "root", name = "Racine"),
  list(id = "A", name = "Enfant A"),
  list(id = "B", name = "Enfant B"),
  list(id = "C", name = "Petit-enfant C"),
  list(id = "D", name = "Petit-enfant D")
)

links <- list(
  list(from = "root", to = "A"),
  list(from = "root", to = "B"),
  list(from = "A", to = "C"),
  list(from = "A", to = "D")
)

highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(inverted = TRUE) %>%   # ← rend l’arbre inversé
  hc_add_series(
    type = "treegraph",
    data = nodes,
    edges = links,
    dataLabels = list(
      style = list(fontSize = "14px")
    ),
    marker = list(radius = 10)
  ) %>%
  hc_title(text = "Arbre inversé simple (highcharter)")


```
